content.hook_text: 3 verses when you need to remember God is still working
content.subtext: For the days when nothing seems to be moving

verses.text: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

content.cta: Which verse reminds you that God is still working?
content.caption:
Some seasons feel like nothing is happening. But God is always working — behind the scenes, in the waiting, in the wilderness. Here are three verses I return to when I need that reminder.

Which one speaks to you today? 💬
